obligations.explanation: The derived parameter μ_ξ, defined as `-log(1 - p_zero) - σ_ξ^2/2`, must have a finite real value at the calibration.
The operands of Add at policy.optimality must be finite real numbers.
the weights (p_zero, 1 - p_zero) of the Mixture declaration buffer_stock:distribution:ξ of ξ each lie in [0, 1] and sum to one

The joint distribution for arvl_to_dcsn is assumed to be the product of the declared conditional distributions given their named parents and the source coordinates: ψ given (k) by buffer_stock:distribution:ψ; ξ given (k) by buffer_stock:distribution:ξ; ψ and ξ are conditionally independent given (k).
The equations at cntn_to_dcsn.value must define cntn_to_dcsn:Aggregation on its declared inputs with values in its declared output sets.
The integrand (Γ*ψ)^(1 - ρ)*V at dcsn_to_arvl.value must be integrable for dcsn_to_arvl.value:Expectation:1 under buffer_stock:distribution:ψ, buffer_stock:distribution:ξ.
The equations at dcsn_to_arvl.value must define dcsn_to_arvl:Aggregation on its declared inputs with values in its declared output sets.
The operands of Add at policy must be finite real numbers.
